Definition: of uncertain affinity; a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the inmost mind:--reins.
BiblicalUsage: The reins are the kidneys, and in the Bible they stand for the hidden inward life — the place where motives and thoughts sit. When Christ says He searches the reins and hearts, He is claiming sight into what no one else can see, and promising to repay each person according to their works.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse keeps me honest: God does not judge the show I put on, He reads the inward parts I cannot hide from Him.
